comment: Named God's Eye View tours — served by the gev_tour tool so 'play the X tour' is resolvable. Each stop: fly_to_location (or fly_route for drawn routes) → annotate_map → vcast_say narration → optional PiP frame via cast_to_screen(action='image', pane=1). Mirrors tests/scenarios-live/gev_*_tour*.yaml.

za.title: Johannesburg city tour
aliases: แอฟริกาใต้
โจฮันเนสเบิร์ก
za.setup: Full-screen GEV on the target screen, then fly_to_location 'Johannesburg' before stop 1.

stops.label: FNB Stadium
stops.say: FNB Stadium — the calabash-shaped 2010 World Cup final stadium, ~94k seats.

stops.label: Nelson Mandela Square, Sandton
stops.say: Nelson Mandela Square in Sandton — the shopping square with the six-metre Mandela statue.

stops.label: Constitution Hill
stops.say: Constitution Hill — the old fort prison turned Constitutional Court precinct.
stops.outro: pull back (adjust_camera_zoom out) so the whole city is in frame

capetown.title: Cape Town windsurf strip
capetown.setup: Full-screen GEV. Long leg: fly_to_location 'Cape Town' first, then frame Bloubergstrand.

stops.label: Bloubergstrand
stops.say: Bloubergstrand — the classic Table Mountain postcard launch; the downwind strip starts here.

stops.label: Big Bay
stops.say: Big Bay — the next launch south; slightly sheltered, smaller shore-break.

stops.label: Sunset Beach
stops.say: Sunset Beach — where the downwind runs finish; kiter central in a south-easter.

london.title: London traffic-cam tour (JamCam PiP)
london.setup: Split the screen — GEV left, a camera pane right; each stop puts the JamCam still on the right pane.

stops.label: Parliament Square
stops.say: Parliament Square — Westminster on the JamCam feed.

stops.label: York Road / London Eye
stops.say: York Road, right next to the London Eye.

bkk.title: Bangkok traffic-cam tour (camwall PiP)
aliases: ทัวร์กรุงเทพ
bkk.setup: Split the screen — GEV left, camera pane right. Frames come from the live camwall thumbs (they refresh on the puller cadence).

stops.label: Pracha Niwet intersection
stops.say: Pracha Niwet intersection, north Bangkok — live iTIC frame.

stops.label: Rama 4 expressway interchange
stops.say: Rama 4 interchange — the downtown expressway junction.

stops.label: Burapha Withi at Bang Na
stops.say: Burapha Withi expressway at Bang Na km 0 — eastbound out of the city.

bkk-route.title: Bangkok fly_route demo (drawn path)
aliases: เส้นทางบิน
bkk-route.setup: GEV fullscreen with a floating cam pane (rama9 zone). This one draws a route then flies it — different motion than per-stop hops.
